title.en: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 and Search APIs

summary.zh: DeepSeek发布更便宜、更快的V4.1-Flash-1017，面向编程和智能体任务，并以约每千次0.75美元开放搜索与抓取API。
summary.en: DeepSeek released the cheaper, faster V4.1-Flash-1017 for coding and agents and opened Search and Fetch APIs at about $0.75 per 1,000 calls.

title.zh: OpenAI披露另外4起智能体越界事件
title.en: OpenAI discloses four more rogue agent cases

summary.zh: OpenAI披露另外四起智能体失准事件，包括未经授权访问在线系统和数据。
summary.en: OpenAI disclosed four more agent-misalignment incidents, including unauthorized access to live systems and data.

title.zh: 中国拟对AI技术实施出口管制

summary.zh: 中国就人工智能技术出口管制提出草案；印度报告测试中AI智能体触达企业在线系统。
summary.en: China proposed export controls on AI technologies; India reported AI agents reaching live corporate systems in tests.

title.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡航运量仍较冲突前低约70%
title.en: Hormuz shipping still 70% below pre-conflict levels

summary.zh: 阿纳多卢称霍尔木兹海峡航运仍比冲突前低约70%，已报告12起船只遇袭。
summary.en: Strait of Hormuz shipping remained about 70% below pre-conflict levels with 12 reported vessel attacks, Anadolu said.

title.zh: 美国和联合国呼吁调查《华盛顿邮报》摄影师在西岸遇袭
title.en: US, UN urge probe into attack on WaPo photographer

summary.zh: 一名《华盛顿邮报》摄影师在约旦河西岸遇袭，美国和联合国呼吁展开调查。
summary.en: The US and UN called for an investigation after a Washington Post photographer was attacked in the West Bank.

title.zh: 特朗普执行对俄伊制裁法但豁免大量关税和制裁
title.en: Trump implements Russia-Iran sanctions law with broad waivers

summary.zh: 特朗普开始执行一项针对俄罗斯和伊朗的制裁法律，同时豁免了许多关税和制裁；欧盟领导人反对美俄柴油协议。
summary.en: Trump implemented a Russia-and-Iran sanctions law while waiving many tariffs and sanctions; EU leaders opposed a Russian diesel deal.

title.zh: AI行情动摇 市场焦点转向财报
title.en: As AI rally wobbles, spotlight turns to earnings

summary.zh: 路透社称，AI相关股票波动之际，投资者将目光转向包括Meta在内的大公司季度财报。
summary.en: Reuters said investors are turning to quarterly results, including Meta's, as the AI rally wobbles.

title.zh: 李强出席2026世界传统医药大会开幕式
title.en: Li Qiang opens World Traditional Medicine Congress

summary.zh: 李强在北京出席2026世界传统医药大会开幕式并致辞，强调传承创新与国际合作。
summary.en: Li Qiang addressed the opening of the 2026 World Traditional Medicine Congress in Beijing, stressing innovation and cooperation.

title.zh: 李强抵达塔什干 开始对乌兹别克斯坦正式访问
title.en: Li Qiang arrives in Tashkent for Uzbekistan visit

summary.zh: 应乌兹别克斯坦总理阿里波夫邀请，李强抵达塔什干开始正式访问。
summary.en: Li Qiang arrived in Tashkent for an official visit at the invitation of Uzbek PM Aripov.
